noProject: Please select or create a project first.
assertionRepairNotApplicable: This is an assertion failure (ASSERTION_FAILURE), so locator repair does not apply. Check the actual value, expected value and test intent; do not change the assertion merely to make the test pass.
missingFailedLocator: No actual failed locator was recorded. Check the original error and page evidence before requesting locator repair.
locatorRepairNotApplicable: The failure is classified as {{classification}}; locator repair does not apply. Diagnose the cause based on the error type first.
noAlternativeLocator: No valid candidate differs from the original locator; no unchanged patch is generated.
openInStudioTitle: Open the failing test file in the Automation Studio
debugFromFailureTitle: Open the failure in Studio and pause on its failure breakpoint
fallbackDiagnosis: The AI provider is unavailable. This preliminary result was generated by local rules.
patchAppliedRerunBlocked: The patch was written, but the verification run did not start. It is not verified.
proposalRejectedDetail: You rejected this proposal. No source changes were made; run a new analysis if you want another proposal.
repairNotVerified: This proposal does not meet the apply requirements; the patch cannot be applied.
repairCandidateVerifiedFromEvidence: The locator matched one visible and enabled control captured during the failed run. The patch is not applied; rerun the original case to confirm the repair.
repairCandidateVerifiedByPlaywright: Playwright verified the candidate locator. The patch is not applied; rerun the original case to confirm the repair.
recurrenceLoadFailed: Could not load similar failure history. Please retry.
recurrenceEmpty: No prior similar occurrences recorded in history for this failure signature.
selectPrompt: Select a test failure to perform AI root-cause diagnosis or generate locator repair proposals.
emptyQueueDescription: When a run records a failure, its evidence and reviewable diagnosis will appear here. No repair is applied without your approval.
jiraSynthesizing: Synthesizing bug details, stack trace, and reproduction steps from failure artifacts...
diagnosisStreamIncomplete: The analysis connection ended without a complete diagnosis. Please retry.
alertRepairLocatorNotFound: The locator {{locator}} was not found in {{file}} — the file may have changed since the failure was recorded.
noDiffAvailable: No diff generated for this proposal.
simulatedDiagnosis: This is a simulated demonstration, not a verified AI diagnosis or repair result.

workflow.title: Failure analysis workflow
workflow.interruptedDetail: A service restart interrupted this analysis. Evidence is retained; unfinished steps are not successful.
workflow.verificationBoundary: A proposal is not a verified repair. Source changes require explicit human approval; only the original test passing can verify the repair.
workflow.attemptLoadFailed: Could not load this attempt's repair record: {{error}}
workflow.statusUnavailableDetail: The failure workflow status could not be read. Reload it before deciding what to do next.
workflow.audit: View full execution record (events, sources and timestamps)
workflow.verificationFailed: Retest did not pass · repair remains unverified
workflow.autoRolledBack: The original test did not pass. The system automatically rolled back the patch and restored the original file.
workflow.rolledBackDetail: The repair patch was rolled back and the original file was restored.
workflow.locatorTimeoutConclusion: The test waited for locator {{locator}} for {{duration}} ms, but the page did not contain it, so the click timed out.
workflow.observedControl: The captured page evidence contains this current control: {{locator}}.
workflow.locatorRepairAdvice: Update the failed locator to the current page locator: {{locator}}.
workflow.locatorRetestAdvice: Rerun the test and confirm both the add-to-cart action and amount assertions pass.
workflow.originalDiagnosis: Show original AI diagnosis and advice
workflow.localDecisionFallback: Jev was not accepted for this decision (reason: {{reason}}); local rules selected the candidate. The original test rerun determines whether the repair works.
workflow.localDecisionLowConfidence: Jev confidence was {{confidence}}, below the configured minimum
workflow.decisionBlocked: Repair was blocked: {{reason}}. No code change was applied and no verification run was started.
workflow.localEvidenceDecision: Jev did not provide an accepted decision; local ranking selected a control captured during the failed run, and the locator matched a visible, enabled and unique control. The original test must still pass to verify the repair.

evidenceBundle: Failure evidence bundle (sources and missing evidence)

primaryActions.RUN_DIAGNOSIS: Run AI diagnosis and prepare repair proposal

rollbackBeforeReanalysis: The applied patch failed verification. Roll it back before re-analysis to preserve the rollback snapshot.

primaryReasons.automationRepairUnavailable: The backend has no controlled code repair proposal and diff review contract. Code repair is unavailable to prevent unattended test edits.
primaryReasons.locatorUnavailable: Locator repair requires a confirmed LOCATOR_CHANGED diagnosis and a recorded failed locator.
primaryReasons.diagnosisRequired: Complete a real diagnosis before deciding whether repair is appropriate.
primaryReasons.jevConfidenceTooLow: Jev did not make a trusted choice above the confidence threshold, so no code was changed. Review the candidates and decision record, then repair manually and rerun the original failed test.
primaryReasons.candidateNotVerified: The Jev candidate did not pass Playwright page verification, so no code was changed. Review the page evidence, then repair manually and rerun the original failed test.
primaryReasons.locatorRepairBlocked: This locator repair did not pass the Jev decision or page verification gate, so no code was changed. Review the decision and page evidence below.
primaryReasons.repairUnavailable: No safe, supported automatic repair path exists for this classification.

manualNextStep: Inspect the failing script in Debug; there is no applicable proposal now. Any script change must be reviewed and approved before writing, then the failed test can be rerun.
manualNextStepOverview: No patch is safe to apply now. Review the failure evidence or inspect the script in Debug; source changes are written only after human approval.
repairRequiresProject: Select a project before starting the analysis and repair task.
codeRepairTaskGoal: Use the failure evidence to propose a minimal Python test script repair for {{nodeid}}. Preserve existing assertions and business expectations; do not write source code without human approval.
codeRepairTaskFailed: Could not start the repair task: {{error}}
analysisNotRun: Analyze the failure and prepare a repair proposal in one flow. The script is written only after you approve it.

summary.browserLaunch: Browser process could not start. Playwright returned EPERM while launching Chromium.
summary.browserLaunchWithPlatform: Browser process could not start. {{platform}} returned EPERM while Playwright attempted to launch Chromium.
summary.locatorTimeout: The locator {{locator}} did not resolve to an element on the page.
summary.assertion: The test assertion did not pass.
summary.environmentHint: This may involve the environment or runtime. This is a heuristic and is unconfirmed.

noRelevantFrames: No project code frames were extracted from the stack.
recorderElementEvidence: Recorder evidence {{version}} · {{count}} captured elements across revisions
recordedVerified: verified when recorded; rechecked for repair
repairUnavailableUntilDiagnosis: Automatic repair is unavailable until diagnosis confirms repairability and sufficient evidence.
repairNotRecommended: Automatic test code changes are not recommended for this failure type.
affectedAreaUnknown: Affected area: unknown (not provided by backend)
sharedFailureSummary: {{count}} failures share the same browser startup error signature.
sharedFailureHeuristic: Read-only heuristic grouping · classification and root cause unconfirmed
groupAnalysisUnavailable: The backend does not support safe group diagnosis yet. Treat this hint as unconfirmed.
repairEligible: Locator proposal is eligible; review and validation are still required

nextActionDescriptions.RUN_DIAGNOSIS: Analyze the failure evidence and prepare a script diff; you decide whether to approve the change.
nextActionDescriptions.ANALYZING: AI is analyzing the recorded failure evidence.
nextActionDescriptions.GENERATE_LOCATOR_REPAIR: Generate a locator repair proposal and inspect its diff. The code will not change until you review and apply it.
nextActionDescriptions.REVIEW_REPAIR: A repair proposal is ready. Review the candidate locator and diff, then complete the semantic review before applying it.
nextActionDescriptions.VERIFY_FIX: The repair has been applied. Rerun the failed test to verify the actual result.
nextActionDescriptions.RETRY: Rerun the failed test to check whether the issue was temporary or environment-related.
nextActionDescriptions.CREATE_ISSUE_DRAFT: The diagnosis points to a product issue. Generate a Jira draft and review its contents.
nextActionDescriptions.VERIFYING: The retest is running. Wait for the actual test result.
nextActionDescriptions.VERIFIED: The retest passed. Review the run record for details.
nextActionDescriptions.BLOCKED: There is no safe automatic action. Use the blocking reason and evidence to decide what to do manually.

autoRepairNotSupported: The backend has no safe generic repair proposal flow, so test code cannot be edited automatically.
repairProposalNotCreated: No repair proposal has been generated
proposalFlowHint: Next: generate a locator repair proposal. It shows the candidate and code diff; source changes only after you review and apply it.
diagnosisMissingSignals: Affected area and risk are not reported by the current diagnosis API.
issueHandoff: Diagnosis is complete. Continue with the recommended issue draft action above; this classification does not enter an automatic test repair stage.
